0.0: Hello, dear hero. I have been keeping up with your phenomenal work from what my men have been reporting to me. #b(Cough)#k I am but a foolish king that lost his castle... It's embarrassing to have to see you like this. Since my #bPrime Minister#k is nowhere to be found, you are literally our only hope. Please slay King Pepe and rescue my #b#p1300002##k.

yes.0: #bKing Pepe#k is trying to arrange a marriage with his dumb son and my #b#p1300002##k. I must prevent that wedding from taking place, so I need you to defeat King Pepe. He has three Yeti brothers guarding him at all times, so it won't be an easy task. Best of luck to you.

no.0: Are you not ready to leave yet? Please prepare yourself for this journey, because there's simply not much time....#b(Cough)#k

1.0: Did you...did you really defeat #bKing Pepe#k?

yes.0: This is beyond comprehension. I can't thank you enough for saving the Empire from such danger! Thank you, thank you!

mob.0: You still have yet to defeat #bKing Pepe#k and his escort Yeti. That just won't do!
